title: Terraform + Vault Provider：用动态 AWS 凭据运行基础设施变更
description: Recreate HashiCorp's Inject secrets into Terraform using the Vault provider tutorial with LocalStack instead of a real AWS account. Use a Vault Admin Terraform workspace to configure the AWS secrets engine and a role with a 120-second TTL, then use an Operator workspace to retrieve dynamic AWS IAM credentials through the Vault provider and create a LocalStack EC2 instance. Finally restrict the Vault role by removing ec2:* and verify that the next Terraform plan fails with an authorization error.

steps.title: 第一步：Vault Admin 工作区配置 AWS secrets engine
第二步：Terraform Operator 领取动态 AWS 凭据创建实例
第三步：销毁实例并观察动态 IAM 凭据回收
第四步：收紧 Vault role 权限并验证 plan 失败
